players.name: James Conner
players.summary: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that he has no new updates on the status of Conner (foot), who is still "working to return to perform," Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports. "It was not a good injury," LaFleur said.

players.name: Gardner Minshew II
players.summary: Minshew (elbow) underwent UCL reconstructive surgery Monday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.summary: out

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.summary: The Ravens believe "there's a chance" that Jackson (thumb) could return for their Week 16 matchup with the Browns, assuming all goes well in his recovery from right thumb surgery, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.summary: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) wasn't spotted on the field for Thursday's practice, Joe Buscaglia of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jackson Hawes
players.summary: Hawes (shoulder) was a late addition to Wednesday's injury report, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News.

players.name: Ray Davis
players.summary: Davis was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice due to a hamstring injury.

players.name: Darren Waller
players.summary: Waller (knee) is suited up for Thursday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Tommy Tremble
players.summary: Tremble didn't practice Wednesday due to a knee issue, with head coach Dave Canales noting after the session that the tight end's injury is a "concern," Steve Reed of the Associated Press reports.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.summary: Brooks (groin) was a full participant at Wednesday's walkthrough.

players.name: Zavier Scott
players.summary: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.summary: Iosivas (thumb) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.summary: Ferguson didn't practice Wednesday due to knee and ankle injuries and won't be available for Sunday's game against the Titans, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jonathan Mingo
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Tyler Goodson
players.summary: The Cowboys placed Goodson (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.summary: Waddle (concussion) was present for Wednesday's practice, Chris Tomasson of the Denver Gazette reports.

players.name: Caleb Lohner
players.summary: The Broncos opened Lohner's (lower body) 21-day practice window Wednesday, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

players.name: Sione Vaki
players.summary: Vaki (ankle) was a limited participant in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.summary: Jacobs (finger) has a "realistic chance" of returning to action Nov. 25 against the Rams following the Packers' Week 11 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Skyy Moore
players.summary: Moore's ankle injury is not considered serious, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Bo Melton
players.summary: Melton (thigh) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Brevin Jordan
players.summary: Jordan (foot/illness) has been ruled out ahead of Thursday night's game against the Colts.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.summary: Harrison (hamstring) has been ruled out for Thursday night's game against the Colts.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.summary: Marks (concussion) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Colts.

players.name: Will Mallory
players.summary: The Colts ruled out Mallory (hamstring) for Thursday night's games against the Texans.

players.name: Anthony Gould
players.summary: Gould (toe) is listed as questionable for Thursday night's game against the Texans, Abby Halpin of the Colts' official site reports.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.summary: Tuten (ankle/foot) was working off to the side during the stretching portion of Thursday's practice, according to Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union.

players.name: LeQuint Allen Jr.
players.summary: Allen (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday, Mia O'Brien of 1010 XL 92.5 FM Jacksonville reports.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.summary: Rodriguez (hand) was listed as a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.summary: Meyers (ankle) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.

players.name: Jared Wiley
players.summary: The Chiefs placed Wiley (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.summary: Walker (groin) won't practice Wednesday, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.summary: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said Wednesday that Bowers (ankle) doesn't need to practice this week to play Sunday against the Broncos, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports. "If he's ready to go, we'll get him out there," Kubiak said.

players.name: Charlie Kolar
players.summary: Kolar (concussion) did not participate at practice Wednesday.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.summary: McConkey (back) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.summary: Thompson (hamstring) is inactive for Monday night's game against the Ravens.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.summary: Douglas (shoulder) continued to don a non-contact jersey during Thursday's practice, Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald reports.

players.name: Jared Wayne
players.summary: Wayne (quadriceps) did not participate at practice Wednesday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.summary: Bell (knee) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that Willis (groin/core) has not undergone surgery and that the Dolphins are still determining if a procedure is needed, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Jeshaun Jones
players.summary: The Vikings signed Jones (shoulder) off the practice squad to the active roster Wednesday.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.summary: Hockenson (wrist) practiced in a limited capacity Wednesday.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.summary: Murray (hamstring) will miss Wednesday's practice, Kevin Seifert of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.summary: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he didn't have a definitive diagnosis for the injury Maye (ankle) sustained in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, but indicated that the quarterback will miss time," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports.  "I wouldn't imagine him being available coming out of the [Week 11] bye," Vrabel said.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.summary: Brown (hamstring) was spotted walking around with a limp in the locker room following Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, Andrew Callahan of the Boston Herald reports.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.summary: Head coach Kellen Moore said Tyson was limited at Wednesday's practice due to a chest injury, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

players.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
players.summary: Tracy (hamstring) could be reinstated from injured reserve when first eligible ahead of the Giants' Week 13 game against the 49ers, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Geno Smith
players.summary: Smith (ankle), who was a limited participant in Wednesday's walkthrough practice, said afterward that he intends to play in Sunday's game against the Chargers, Rich Cimini of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Isaiah Williams
players.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Williams won't practice Wednesday due to a rib injury, Eric Allen of the Jets' official site reports.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.summary: Cooper (ankle) isn't practicing Wednesday, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.summary: Wicks (ankle) is participating in practice Thursday, Andrew DiCecco of InsideTheBirds.com reports.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.summary: Smith (hamstring) is taking part in Thursday's practice, Andrew DiCecco of InsideTheBirds.com reports.

players.name: Will Shipley
players.summary: Shipley (foot) was a limited practice participant Wednesday.

players.name: Britain Covey
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.summary: Pittman (foot) participated in practice Thursday, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.summary: Wilson (finger), who was designated for return from injured reserve earlier Wednesday, was a full participant in his return to practice.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.summary: San Francisco general manager John Lynch said that "there's a chance" Evans (Achilles) will take part in a padded practice Thursday, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

players.name: Christian Kirk
players.summary: Kirk announced Wednesday via his personal Instagram account that he recently underwent meniscus surgery.

players.name: Mac Jones
players.summary: Jones (illness) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.summary: Stribling (ankle) was doing some work on the side at Wednesday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.summary: Aiyuk's agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Tuesday that the receiver is "100 percent healthy" and fully recovered from his November 2024 right knee surgery and plans to work out for interested teams once he's released by the 49ers, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.

players.name: George Holani
players.summary: Holani is week-to-week after suffering an MCL sprain in Sunday's win over Las Vegas, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.summary: Mayfield (foot/right thumb) said that he felt good but was "limited" at Thursday's practice, and he's hopeful to do more at Friday's session, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.summary: Spears (knee) didn't practice Wednesday.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.summary: Tate (shoulder) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.

players.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
players.summary: Coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday that Robinson (ankle) -- who was placed on IR on Tuesady -- is out for the rest of the season, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.summary: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn confirmed that Croskey-Merritt (groin) will practice Thursday, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

players.name: Colson Yankoff
players.summary: questionable
